column1: # The images of USER-GUIDE.md. One line per image, fields separated by a TAB:
#   name (file in docs/img)   scene (file in tests/scenes, without .scene)   size   shot (the "shot" line in the scene)
# make-doc-images.sh renders exactly these scenes and copies each shot to docs/img/<name>.
# Names starting with "annot-" are drawn on by annotate.py (docs/annotate.py) after the copy.
# Add a line here and a picture in USER-GUIDE.md to add an image; change the scene/size/shot to change what it shows.
